title: wrangler d1 execute fails with 'SQL code did not contain a statement' when a comment holds a semicolon
symptoms: SQL code did not contain a statement
Migration file runs fine in sqlite3 locally
Removing the trailing commented SQL makes it pass
cause: Older Wrangler split SQL files on every semicolon, including ones inside comments, which produced an empty statement. Wrangler 3.109.3 made the splitter skip comments.
fix: Upgrade Wrangler to 3.109.3 or later, or remove semicolons from comments in migration files.
apply:
npm i -D wrangler@latest
npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
